sources.title: GitHub - deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
sources.snippet: When evaluating model performance, it is recommended to conduct multiple tests and average the results. Additionally, we have observed that the DeepSeek-R1 series models tend to bypass thinking pattern (i.e., outputting "<think>\n\n</think>") when responding to certain queries, which can adversely affect the model's performance.
